cohort: Patients who delivered at the China-Japan Friendship Hospital from January 2014 to December 2018 (n=8931)
finding: The study found that the implementation of the universal two-child policy in China led to an increase in the birth rate, percentage of elderly pregnant women, and rate of cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The primary cesarean section rates in 2017 and 2018 were significantly lower than those in 2014, 2015, and 2016.
